description: Source code for animation handling in the cgame module of Unvanquished, including functions for animation frame interpolation, skeleton building, and blending.

methods.name: CG_AnimNumber
methods.description: Returns the raw animation number by removing toggle and force bits.

methods.name: CG_RunLerpFrame
methods.description: Interpolates animation frames based on current time, handling looping and end conditions.

methods.name: CG_RunMD5LerpFrame
methods.description: Resets frame data if animation changed, then calls CG_RunLerpFrame.

methods.name: CG_BlendLerpFrame
methods.description: Calculates blending factor for animation transitions based on half-life.

methods.name: CG_BuildAnimSkeleton
methods.description: Builds and blends skeletons for current animation state.
